summary: USB DirectFlow full-stack smoke+flow tests passed. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases green (root, status create+persist, /api/samples structure+content, /api/sample-file/transfer-report.txt plain text, /api/sample-file/telemetry.json JSON 120 samples, 404 for unknown sample, CORS). Frontend: Connect simulated USB drive -> drive-status-card with usage bar, source-toggle switches INTERNET<->PHONE MEDIA (pick-media and pick-doc rendered), URL input populates selected-item, sample chips (video/audio/image/text/json) populate selected-item, compress-switch toggles, START STREAM runs the pipeline — transfer-console shows PHASE/metrics (WRITTEN/TOTAL/SPEED/GZIP tag), transfer-progress fills to 100%, success toast appears, drive usage/file count updates. CANCEL button appears while running. Browse tab lists streamed files with correct size/kind, GZIP badge on compressed docs (transfer-report.txt 1.2 KB -> 3.1 KB), delete button removes a row, pull-to-refresh available. Preview: image shows image-view, audio shows timeline-slider + play-toggle with real duration 6:12, doc preview shows doc-text decompressed content with gzip banner, preview-back returns. Video preview renders header + timeline-slider + play-toggle (scrub drag works) but the video frame itself does NOT render in web preview — this is expected because expo-video's web viewport is limited (and simulated drive). Deprecated packages: NONE found in package.json. Minor runtime warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' logged from a dependency.

react_native_issues.issue: testID='video-view' does not propagate to the DOM in web preview, so playwright cannot assert on it; the surrounding scrubber/play-toggle render but the video frame area is black in web (expected limitation of expo-video on web with simulated drive). Reference: /app/frontend/app/preview/[id].tsx:146

Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' is logged repeatedly from a dependency. Not blocking but should be tracked. Likely originates in react-native-reanimated / segmented control. Reference: console warnings during /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx render

action_items: (Optional) Wrap VideoView in a View that also carries testID='video-view' so web preview tests can verify its presence, e.g. <View testID="video-view"><VideoView ..."/></View>, or add a conditional web-only poster. Current behaviour is acceptable because video playback is a native-only feature per the problem statement.
(Optional) Investigate the recurring 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warning (likely from an upstream dependency) — bump the offending lib or suppress.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; use lifespan instead (non-blocking).
/api/sample-file/transfer-report.txt returns ~3KB of generated text; /api/sample-file/telemetry.json returns 120 datapoints — both compress very well, which matches the UX for the GZIP badge demo.
No MongoDB _id leakage detected in /api/status response (serialised via Pydantic StatusCheck).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (video playback frame not expected on web)

seed_data_creation: One StatusCheck row created with client_name='TEST_usb_directflow_backend_tests' during pytest run; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL used for curl/pytest: $EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All endpoints under /api/*. Simulated USB drive is attached instantly by tapping [data-testid=connect-button]; subsequent transfers only need a sample chip + [data-testid=start-button]. Compressed-doc preview is best observed via sample-transfer-report.txt or sample-telemetry.json. The PHONE MEDIA pickers are native-only (expo-image-picker / expo-document-picker) and only the pick-media / pick-doc buttons should be asserted on web.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. The one web-preview oddity (video-view testID not visible in DOM, blank video area) is a known limitation of expo-video on web combined with the simulated drive URI; the surrounding scrubber UI (timeline-slider, play-toggle) works correctly.
